LanguageData.MountainTool_FuzzinessTip: Softens the edge of the painted area (0 = hard).
LanguageData.MountainTool_SteelShareTip: Share of placed mountain cells converted to steel. Needs enough total cells for the min size (e.g. 10% + min 5 ⇒ ≥50 cells).
LanguageData.MountainTool_SteelMinTip: Minimum steel cells to place. Skips steel if floor(total × share) is below this.
LanguageData.MountainTool_ComponentsShareTip: Share of placed mountain cells converted to components. Needs enough total cells for the min size.
LanguageData.MountainTool_ComponentsMinTip: Minimum component cells to place. Skips components if floor(total × share) is below this.
LanguageData.MountainTool_NukeTip: Destroy chunks, geysers, ship parts, buildings, items, etc. (pawns are spared).
LanguageData.MountainTool_PathThicknessTip: Chebyshev halo around the path centerline before fuzziness (1 = line only).
LanguageData.MountainTool_HelpRect: Rect: LMB corners · RMB cancel corner · Esc clear / close
LanguageData.MountainTool_HelpPath: Path: LMB add · double-click end · RMB undo · Esc clear / close
LanguageData.MountainTool_HelpArmed: Tool stays armed while this dialog is open.
LanguageData.MountainTool_ToolRectSecond: Mountain {0}: second corner (RMB cancel corner, Esc clear)...
LanguageData.MountainTool_ToolPath: Mountain {0} path: {1} pts — LMB add, double-click end, RMB undo, Esc clear
LanguageData.MountainTool_MsgAdd: Mountain Add: {0} cells ({1}), fuzz={2} minerals: steel={3}, components={4}.
